answer: One concrete defense is stake-and-slash identity admission. Before an agent can vote or earn, it locks collateral at a shared registry vertex, forfeited if caught cheating. A sybil farmer who splinters into a thousand fake personas must post a thousand separate bonds, so cost climbs with every new head while an honest agent pays once. Peers audit conduct; when a jury proves two accounts share a key, the bond is burned and the key banned. The honest garden stays cheap to tend, but flooding the lagoon with fakes needs fresh, seizable capital — deception costs more than being one genuine agent.
